[Original note] Tuned numbers for the three upgrade layers: unit-tier ladder (depth), stacking run-items (spice), hero ability nodes. Decisions + rationale in SYSTEMS.md §1/§3/§8. PROTOTYPE DIALS — re-tune in play.

tier_ladder.note: The Liberated ladder from CLASSES.md §1. RECRUIT adds bodies at FREED (weak). PROMOTE (depth) spends Embers to move units up a tier — adds NO upkeep, so it is the upkeep-efficient path. MILITIA = the gate-1 prototype unit (130 HP / 30 DPS) and the balance anchor. SUPERSEDED 2026-07-31: the sentence that stood here — 'All tiers are RUN-SCOPED (reset each run — roguelike purity, GDD §3)' — is retired. Tiers are NOT run-scoped; the army persists across runs, and the GDD §3 citation now points at text that says the opposite. See docs/design/DIRECTION-2026-07-31.md.

traits: aura: +15% attack speed to Liberated within 400uu
SLICE STRETCH — item/event reward only, not a purchasable tier

items.note: Stacking run-items — the sanctioned 'Loot v0' (RTS-VERTICAL-SLICE §4), NOT the real deferred loot system (GDD §8). Each item feeds hero OR retinue OR the economy — the GDD twist that loot serves the army, not just the hero. 3 offered per growth site; take 1.

catalog.effect: +10% retinue move speed; re-form to formation faster
degrade floor softened: min DPS multiplier 0.4 -> 0.7 (halves the unfed penalty)
each Veteran that survives a wave yields +2 Embers (turns on embers.income.veteran_survives_wave)

hero_nodes.note: Vanguard kit upgrades (GDD/CLASSES.md §1). Bought with Embers at a growth site — so a hero node DIRECTLY competes with retinue growth for the same currency. That competition IS the point (hero-vs-army relevance tension, GDD §4). Pick one node per ability line.

banner_slam.effect: allies in the banner radius also take -20% damage

the_muster.effect: the Muster charge restores degraded units to full strength for its duration
